blocks.text: Rincón de la Vieja – Tenorio and Río Celeste

paragraphs.text: Day 3 · Transfer to Tenorio Volcano for a guided hike in search of the blue waterfall of Río Celeste, near the Tenorio and Miravalles volcanoes. Walk at your own pace with your nature guide through the dense rainforest of Tenorio Volcano National Park to Los Teñideros, where two rivers meet and the water turns a celestial turquoise. According to a Maleku legend, God dipped His brush in the river while painting the sky; science explains that tiny aluminosilicate particles suspended in the water scatter the sunlight, making the river glow blue. Overnight at Tenorio Lodge. (B)
